logline: 가난한 목수가 깎은 나무 인형이 어느 날 저 혼자 움직이기 시작한다.
destination: 학교로 가는 길 — 인형이 처음으로 스스로 고르는 갈림길
protagonist: 뾰족한 코에 뾰족 모자를 쓴 나무 인형 소년
anchor: a carved wooden puppet boy with a pointed nose, jointed limbs and a paper cone hat
palette: warm pine gold, workshop brown, cool street grey, soft amber

puppet.label: 나무 인형
puppet.desc: a carved wooden puppet boy, visible joints at knees and elbows, a long pointed nose, paper cone hat, short trousers
puppet.avoid: 살아 있는 사람 아이가 아니다 — 나뭇결과 이음매가 보인다

carpenter.label: 목수 할아버지
carpenter.desc: a small round-shouldered Italian man in his sixties, white moustache, leather apron over a patched shirt, spectacles

cat_fox.label: 길에서 만난 둘
cat_fox.desc: a lanky fox in a torn frock coat and a scruffy cat in a battered hat, both walking upright

workshop.label: 목수의 방
workshop.desc: a cramped carpenter's room, wood shavings on the floor, hand tools on pegs, a small stove

beats.visual: an old carpenter carving a puppet from a log at a cluttered workbench, shavings falling
beats.motion: his chisel bites into the wood, shavings curl off and drop, the stove glow flickers

beats.visual: a wooden puppet standing up by itself on a workbench among tools and shavings
beats.motion: the puppet pushes itself upright on the bench, shavings scatter, a tool rocks over

beats.visual: a wooden puppet bolting through a doorway into a street, an old carpenter behind it
beats.motion: the puppet runs out through the door away from him, his apron flaps, dust lifts

beats.beat: 목수가 제 외투를 팔아 책 한 권을 쥐여 준다.
beats.visual: an old man in shirtsleeves pressing a book into a wooden puppet's hands on a cold street
beats.motion: the book passes into the puppet's hands, the man's breath clouds, wind pulls his shirt

beats.visual: an upright fox in a frock coat and a cat in a battered hat blocking a puppet on a lane
beats.motion: the two step into the puppet's path toward it, the fox's tail sweeps, dust rises

beats.beat: 인형이 책을 내주고 반짝이는 것을 받는다.
beats.visual: a wooden puppet handing over a book and taking coins from a fox's paw on a lane
beats.motion: the book leaves its hands, coins drop into its palm, the cat leans in closer

beats.visual: a wooden puppet alone on a road, its pointed nose noticeably longer, hands half raised
beats.motion: the nose grows outward a little further, its hands lift toward its face, dust drifts

beats.beat: 빈 길바닥에 책 한 권이 떨어져 있다.
beats.visual: a dropped book lying open on an empty dirt road at dusk, pages stirring, hedgerow beyond
beats.motion: the pages lift and turn in the wind, dust blows across the road, light fades

withheld: 인형이 진짜 아이가 되는 과정과, 고래 뱃속에서 목수를 다시 만나는 결말
